The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime/FIR No. 1185 of 2019, under Sections 406/471/468/467/420 and 419 IPC, Gomti Nagar,
District Lucknow.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The coordinate Bench of this Court while granting interim protection to the applicant vide order dated 07.03.2024 has passed the following order:-

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri M.K. Singh, Shri Mohd. Alishah Faruqi and Shri Azizullah Khan have filed their power/ Vakalatnama on behalf of complainant/ informant and the same is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Mohd. Mansoor, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Mohd. Alishah Faruqi, learned counsel for the complainant/informant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Jaykirat Singh in Case Crime/FIR No. 1185 /2019, under Sections 406, 471, 468, 467, 420 & 419 IPC, Police Station Gomtinagar, District Lucknow,
with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicants while pressing the anticipatory bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.
The allegations which have been levelled in the FIR are false, concocted and could not believed.

5. It is vehemently submitted that having regard to the apprehension shown by the informant, co-accused Amit Kumar as well as the applicant has placed another property for hypothetication and even if still there is any suspicion and apprehension the same may only be termed as a civil dispute existing between the parties.

6. It is vehemently submitted that during the course of investigation the applicant has approached this Court by filing a Writ Petition (M/B) No. 34764 of 2019 and vide order dated 13.12.2019 protection from arrest till submission of police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. was granted and thereafter he thoroughly cooperated in the investigation and there was no occasion for the Investigating Officer to arrest him and the charge sheet has now been filed without arresting him and he under takes that he will cooperate in trial as he has cooperated in the investigation.

7. The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is also to the tune that identically placed co-accused Amit Kumar has been granted anticipatory bail, vide order dated 20.02.2024 passed in Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 313 of 2024.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 313 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Learned AGA as well as Shri Mohd. Alishah Faruq, learned counsel for the complainant opposes the submissions made on behalf of the applicant.
Shri Mohd.
Alishah Faruqi submits that he may be granted some time to file counter affidavit.

9. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that prima facie, the case of the instant applicant appears to be at par with co-accused Amit Kumar who has already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court.
However, the matter require further consideration.

sentences.text: List on 29.3.2024 in first 20 cases of the cause list, by showing the names of Shri M.K. Singh, Shri Mohd. Alishah Faruqi and Shri Azizullah Khan as counsel for the complainant / informant in the cause list, by which date State as well as complainant may file counter affidavit.
( 3) The applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of the Court.

9. List as directed on 29.03.2024 in the first 20 cases of the cause list, by which date State as well as complainant may file objections/ counter affidavit."
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that charge sheet in the matter has been filed.
He further submits that Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 No.313 of 2024 of the co-accused Amit Kumar has been allowed by this Court vide order dated 31.08.2024.
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks parity with the order of the co-accused.
Learned AGA does not dispute that it is a case of parity.

On due consideration to the fact that anticipatory bail application of the co-accused Amit Kumar has been allowed and the interim protection granted by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 07.03.2024 is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
In view of the above, since, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed, if the applicant is summoned to face trial for offence in question, he shall be released on bail by the trial court on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned with the following conditions:-
Jaykirat Singh vs State Of U.P Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133824175/
